INDEPENDENT CARGO INSPECTION REPORT

Report: IR-260518-44     Claim: FCL-2026-0147
Inspection date: 2026-05-18     Location: MetroMart DC18, Dallas, TX
PRO: BLF-77209115     BOL: BOL-884219
Inspector: Southwest Cargo Survey LLC / L. Greene

________________________________________

Observed shipment condition

- Consignee records 58 of 60 cartons received; 2 cartons not present at inspection.
- Five cartons showed crush, puncture and/or moisture damage: C-017, C-018, C-021, C-022, C-023.
- Internal molded foam inserts were present in all five opened cartons.
- No evidence of product damage was observed in the 6 units classified as repackable.

Unit disposition

Carton | Units | Unsellable | Repackable | Primary observation
C-017 | 4 | 3 | 1 | Corner crush / shell deformation
C-018 | 4 | 2 | 2 | Moisture + retail box damage
C-021 | 4 | 4 | 0 | Puncture / cracked housings
C-022 | 4 | 2 | 2 | Compression / retail box damage
C-023 | 4 | 3 | 1 | Side crush / screen damage

TOTAL: 20 units examined; 14 unsellable; 6 functional but require repacking.

Cost documentation supplied by Northstar

Inspection fee: $420.00     Repack labor: $300.00

Inspector conclusion

The observed physical damage is consistent with compression/puncture during handling or transit.
The presence of molded foam provides some internal protection; however, no vendor packaging
specification or laboratory packaging test was provided to the inspector.

Photos supplied to surveyor: only C-021 and C-023.

Signed: L. Greene     05/18/2026
